india.one_line: CERT-In released AI security auditing guidelines as reports highlight enterprise adoption trends, GCC partnerships, and monetisation strategies.

themes.title: CERT-In issues AI security guidelines
themes.text: CERT-In released security auditing guidelines for autonomous AI systems, mandating checks for unauthorised tool use and emergency-stop mechanisms across four risk tiers.

stories.headline: CERT-In issues AI security auditing guidelines for autonomous systems

themes.title: Enterprise AI adoption and partnerships grow
themes.text: Reports indicate that Indian IT firms and Global Capability Centres are forming partnerships and focusing on enterprise AI monetisation, with top customer service adopters seeing significant KPI gains.
